name: Music Studio
description: A complete production studio by voice or on screen: Nuxiva composes whole songs, writes and translates lyrics, adds drums, bass, chords, melodies, effects and vocals, and you refine everything with timeline, piano roll, step sequencer, mixer and effects.
capabilities: Creates a song from one sentence: genre, key, progression, structure, instruments and lyrics
Works even without the brain thanks to a rule-based arrangement engine
Adds drums, bass, chords, pads, arpeggios, melody, effects and vocals on request
Translates lyrics and sings them in the new language with Nuxiva's voices
Track timeline, piano roll, step sequencer, mixer with pan, mute, solo and per-track effects
20 synthesized instruments and 8 effects (equalizer, filter, delay, reverb, chorus, distortion, compressor, phaser)
Exports the mix as WAV and the reopenable project to the shared folder «08 Produzioni»
